title: Rocket checks — PM daily scratchpad
content:
Quick context:
Personal scratchpad for the Hosted API rollout preflight. Not polished — use as working notes and ephemeral to-do/follow-up list. Date range: focused on the sprint ending Fri (canary start).

Morning brain dump (top priorities)
- Finalize PRD edits for streaming behavior section (section 3.2). Small wording change: make fallback semantics explicit — 'if model variant unavailable then route to compatible lower-tier variant with XPS delta documented). Need legal ok on data residency sentence.
- Confirm canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 75% (over 4 hours each step). Double-check autoscale thresholds with infra.
- Cross-check rollback playbook with SRE (who owns which alert?)

PRD edits (micro tasks)
- Reword streaming API example so the function-calling block is shorter; add example showing structured JSON output (edge case: empty tool responses).
- Add note about tokenization differences for quantized models (prod teams keep an eye). Add link to model-catalog entry.
- Insert explicit acceptance criteria: "no P95 spike > 20% over baseline for 30m during canary" and "error budget consumed < 5% for first 24h".
- TODO: inline the TTLs for cache keys in the Batching section. (PROD-4237 references)

Stakeholder follow-ups (who I need to ping)
- @Daniel: quick confirm on canary percent schedule and who will run the ramp command.
- @Priya (CS lead): draft the CS playbook blurb about expected customer experience and known limitations. Need by EOD.
- Infra: ping Sandeep for autoscale headroom numbers + nightly maintenance windows.
- Legal: Rachel — request a 1-paragraph approval on the residency phrasing.

Launch / preflight checklist (working, not final)
- [ ] Merge PRD edits and notify doc reviewers (tag: product, infra, legal)
- [ ] Finalize canary config (traffic percentages, step durations)
- [ ] Run smoke suite on staging with streaming enabled (cover >20 concurrent users)
- [ ] Verify KV cache warmup script works on dedicated shards
- [ ] Confirm observability dashboards have burn-in panels (latency by model, tokens/sec, errors)
- [ ] Prepare rollback commands + runbook snippet in PagerDuty escalation notes
- [ ] Draft short customer comms post-launch (one paragraph + link to changelog)

Notes from standup (10m)
- Infra: GPU pool reserved, but pods may be thinned if maintenance triggers — need scheduled window.
- SRE: Alert on model fallback chatter already exists but need a higher-severity channel for on-call.
- Dev: small API contract change (optional field in response) — backward compatible but call it out to SDKs.

Risks and mitigations (quick)
- Risk: Quantized variant yields subtle hallucination differences -> Mitigation: quality monitoring with golden prompt set + immediate rollback threshold.
- Risk: Rapid traffic ramp overwhelms cache -> Mitigation: pre-warm prefix cache and increase initial batch size for first 10 minutes.
- Risk: Legal asks to remove 'analytics' token logging -> Mitigation: replace with aggregated telemetry only and update docs.

Decisions to make (pending)
- Can we allow pull-forward on canary schedule if early metrics are green? (Propose: allow product lead + infra on-call to accelerate to next step at 15m with explicit signoff)
- Should we expose the fallback reasoning in responses (for debugging) or keep it internal? (Tradeoff: debuggability vs. leak of infrastructure details)

Short-term timeline (today)
- 09:00–09:30: sync with infra (autoscale numbers)
- 10:00–10:30: doc edits + upload to confluence (link in artifacts)
- 11:00–11:15: quick call with CS to agree on comms
- 13:00–14:00: smoke test run on staging (invite dev + infra)
- by 17:00: merge + notify launch channel

Notes to self / scratch (informal)
- Keep final PRD header short — engineers skip long intros.
- Use neutral phrasing for SLA language: "target" vs "guarantee". Legal will insist on the latter being explicit.
- Remember to paste the canary JSON into the ticket so infra doesn't have to hunt in Confluence.
- If SRE asks for a different rollback window, escalate to me immediately.

Post-launch quick metrics to capture (first 2h)
- P50 / P95 latency by model variant
- Error rate (5xx) by endpoint and model variant
- Token throughput (tokens/sec) vs baseline
- Observability: any sudden increase in 'fallback' metric

Random micro-notes (brainstorm style)
- Could we add a 'graceful-degrade' header that signals when response is served by fallback? Use this only for internal customers first.
- Idea: small UI tweak for partners: show 'estimated token cost' for preview responses — helps CS set expectations.

Unresolved questions (flagged)
- Do we have legal signoff on the residency sentence? (Rachel)
- Can we make the canary rollback automatic on SLO breach or keep manual? (ops preference?)

End of day wrap (what I'll check before logging off)
- Confirm PRD merged
- Confirm 1st smoke run results (attach logs)
- Confirm CS playbook draft in shared folder
- If any blocking issues remain, escalate via #launch-escalations and call on-call.

-- a note for tomorrow morning --
- Re-run golden prompt quality suite and compare embeddings drift (low priority but useful)

(Sign-off: ephemeral log — delete or tidy before adding to more formal doc)
